messages:
ellie.docs: FYI I opened PR to clarify SOC2 audit-log retention wording + add quick SDK snippets (curl + python) — https://git.company/repos/docs/pulls/860
noah.sec: linking. what's the specific change?
ellie.docs: make it explicit that default behavior pseudonymizes tenant and user ids, include example fields (`tenant_pseudonym`) and call out the redaction request path for customers needing irreversible de-identification
rachel.legal: please note: redaction requests require legal review and may be limited by preservation obligations (e.g., subpoenas). add that language.
ellie.docs: will add: "Redaction is available by request and requires legal approval; it does not prevent disclosure when required by lawful process."
noah.sec: add a short ops note: redaction irreversibly de-identifies identifiers in customer-visible indexes but systems retain a hashed internal reference for tracing and compliance. keep it concise.
ellie.docs: added that sentence and two tiny examples:

```
# curl (producer)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"file.upload","tenant_pseudonym":"t-5f4e","meta":{"filename":"report.pdf"}}'

# python (sdk)
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient()
client.write_event(type="file.upload", tenant_pseudonym="t-5f4e", meta={"filename":"report.pdf"})
```

ellie.docs: also added the redaction request example snippet:

```
POST /v1/tenant/:id/redact
Body: {"scope":"audit_events","since":"2022-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
Response: 202 Accepted
```

rachel.legal: wording looks good. change 'may be limited by preservation obligations' -> 'may be constrained by legal preservation obligations'.
noah.sec: :thumbsup:
dev-tools-bot: CI: docs lint passed (commit c9d12f). build #1229
ellie.docs: merged. I'll add a one-line note to the compliance release checklist. thanks! :tada:
